products.title: SAMSUNG T35F 24" FHD 1920x1080 IPS 75Hz 5ms (GTG) Office Monitor
products.description: The SAMSUNG T35F is a 24-inch Full HD (1920x1080) office monitor designed for a clean, modern workspace with a 3-sided borderless display. It features an IPS panel for consistent color accuracy from any angle, a 75Hz refresh rate for smooth visuals, and a 5ms (GTG) response time. To enhance the user experience, it includes AMD Radeon FreeSync™ to reduce image tearing, Game Mode for optimized contrast, and eye care technology featuring Flicker-Free and Eye Saver Mode. Connectivity options include one HDMI 1.4 port and one VGA (D-sub) port, and it is VESA mount compatible.

products.title: 24 Inch FHD IPS 100Hz Monitor with Slim Stand
products.description: The LG 24BA650-I is a 23.8-inch Full HD monitor designed for productivity and versatility. It features an IPS panel with a 1920 x 1080 resolution, a smooth 100 Hz refresh rate to minimize motion blur, and a 5 ms response time. The monitor is equipped with a variety of connectivity options, including HDMI, DisplayPort 1.4, and a USB-C port that supports video, data, and up to 65W power delivery. For enhanced comfort, it includes a Reader Mode to reduce blue light and a fully adjustable stand (height, tilt, pivot, and swivel), making it ideal for multi-monitor setups.

products.description: This HP Series 7 Pro 724pn is a 24-inch flat IPS monitor designed for both work and entertainment.
